std::string ak375(int n, const std::string& str) {
    int res1 = 0;
    int res2 = 0;
    int currentOutsideLen = 0;
    bool insideParen = false;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        char c = str[i];
        if (c == '(') {
            insideParen = true;
            ++res2;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            insideParen = false;
            if (currentOutsideLen > res1) {
                res1 = currentOutsideLen;
            }
            currentOutsideLen = 0;
        } else {
            if (!insideParen) {
                ++currentOutsideLen;
            }
        }
    }
    if (currentOutsideLen > res1) {
        res1 = currentOutsideLen;
    }

    return std::to_string(res1) + " " + std::to_string(res2);
}

int main() {
    int n;
    while (std::cin >> n) {
        std::string str;
        std::cin >> str;
        std::string res = ak375(n, str);
        std::cout << res << std::endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
